categories.label: Plastic
categories.description: Bottles, tubs, trays, film and other packaging moulded from plastics such as PET, HDPE or polypropylene.
examples: Cling film, bread bags and carrier bags

categories.label: Paper
categories.description: Printed and writing paper such as newspapers, magazines, envelopes and office sheets, with no plastic coating.
examples: Greetings cards without glitter or foil
Shredded paper, contained in a paper bag

categories.label: Cardboard
categories.description: Corrugated shipping boxes and thinner paperboard packaging such as cereal boxes, egg trays and drink cartons.
examples: Egg boxes and paper fruit trays
Beverage cartons for milk and juice
Pizza boxes with no greasy residue

categories.label: Glass
categories.description: Container glass only: bottles and jars that once held drinks, food, sauces or cosmetics, empty and lid removed.
examples: Glass olive oil and vinegar bottles

categories.label: Metal
categories.description: Household metal packaging and small metal objects: steel food tins, aluminium cans, foil, trays and empty aerosols.
examples: Clean aluminium foil and foil trays
Empty aerosol cans, such as deodorant
Metal jar lids and bottle caps
Clean metal pie and takeaway dishes

categories.label: Organic / Food
categories.description: Food scraps, cooked leftovers and garden trimmings that can be composted or digested into biogas and soil conditioner.

categories.label: Electronics
categories.description: Anything with a plug, a battery or a circuit board, from phones and cables to kettles, toys and small appliances.

categories.label: Hazardous
categories.description: Household chemicals and products that burn, corrode, poison or start fires in collection trucks if binned normally.
examples: Motor oil, brake fluid and antifreeze
Nail polish, solvents and gas canisters

categories.label: Textiles
categories.description: Clothing, footwear and household fabric, whether wearable or worn out, kept clean and dry for reuse or fibre recycling.
examples: Shoes and boots, tied in pairs

categories.label: General Waste
categories.description: Items with no local recycling route, plus anything the classifier is unsure about — when in doubt, this is the safe bin.
examples: Composite pouches for pet food or coffee
